# Update ETH Send Config to 20 Confirmations + 4 DVNs (All Pathways)

## Summary

Update the send ULN config on Ethereum for messages going to Base (EID 30184), HyperEVM (EID 30367), and Flare (EID 30295) to require 20 confirmations and 4 DVNs (replacing Google Cloud with Canary).
